prompt:
A desktop e-commerce homepage for First Nutrition, an official sports-supplement distributor in Jordan and Lebanon, rendered edge to edge as a finished website screen with crisp, readable text; no browser window, device or desk around it.

The visitor's job: pick a training goal and order the right supplements on WhatsApp, cash on delivery. What leads is the goal choice as running lanes. The top of the page is a red tartan athletics track seen from above, its white lane lines curving across the full width; four lanes carry big painted numerals 1 to 4 and the names BULK, CUT, BUILD MUSCLE, PERFORM. Lane 3 is selected and its stack waits at its finish line: Optimum Nutrition Gold Standard 100% Whey 50 JOD, MuscleTech Platinum Creatine 28 JOD, Scivation Xtend 30 JOD, with a button 'Order on WhatsApp'. Headline painted on the track: 'Pick your lane.' A line: 'Official distributor · 21 brands · ISO certified · Cash on delivery across Jordan'. Below, the next section starts on white: 'Best sellers' with real supplement tub photos and JOD prices (Dymatize ISO 100 from 50 JOD, MuscleTech Nitro Tech 100% Whey Gold 75 JOD, Cellucor C4 Original from 30 JOD).

Frame: the First Nutrition wordmark at top left, navigation Shop, Brands, Offers, Branches, About, a search field, a Jordan · JOD switch, an العربية language switch, and a cart.

Visual law: drenched tartan red #C8372D with crisp white lane paint owns the top of the page; the rest is white with pale infield grey. Type like stadium signage and painted lane numerals: wide, bold, upright grotesk. Photographic track texture, bright daylight, energetic but not aggressive.
